name: PlanSource
summary: PlanSource is a benefits administration platform for open enrollment, eligibility tracking, ACA reporting and COBRA. Its Boost Carrier Integration Program connects carriers through APIs instead of weekly files, and a Plan Configuration API pulls plans, rates and rules from carrier systems; the vendor says it is live with Guardian, MetLife and Mutual of Omaha. PlanSource publishes no prices, and its pricing address redirects to a contact page.

facts.text: The vendor says its Plan Configuration API pulls plans, rates and rules directly from carrier systems, and that setup and renewals that took weeks can finish in minutes.
The Boost network section shows 18 carrier logos, and the page gives no total carrier count.
The FAQ on the product page lists eligibility tracking, dependent verification, ACA reporting and COBRA administration among the compliance needs it supports.
The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and HIPAA, with reports available on request.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No prices published. The pricing address redirects to the contact page, which offers a demo and a sales form
